The 06:59:28Z cycle snapshot completed. PR 595's two finding repairs are

over reviewed `00e2079f`. The fix changes eight files, 223 insertions and
25 deletions. The parent, clean worktree and 15 artifact hashes were verified.
The full formalization goal remains active.

under member claims, and verifies accepted and dropped member pins at
publication. F2 checks every unpublished commit's paths and modes before
telemetry synchronization, including changes later reverted. The accepted
507/579/592 transport and runtime deployment patch remain unchanged.
These are author results awaiting independent recheck.

06:53:04.759Z-07:07:53.876Z: 889.117 seconds within 899.923 effective,
one actual turn. Task delta: 6,399,619 input, 6,263,168 cached input,
26,133 output and 9,217 reasoning tokens. The thread is retired. Original
Tesla/Pasteur work, failures and costs remain recorded without a reset.

Nine adapter tests, eight selected train scenarios and the dropped-pin
verifier regression passed. The normal commit hook ran 741 tests with nine
skipped in 250.352 seconds. Exact-head CI passed all nine statuses in
383 seconds; all eight gates ran, with 741 tests and nine skipped. The
rooted audit passed 1,659 declarations, zero failures and three existing
statement warnings. Published HEAD and final Testing metadata were verified.
Evidence: `native-audits/pr595-findings-fix-01a0b34a/` and
`/tmp/pr595-c55a4069-publication-final-20260918.json`.

MAIN released the fix claim at 07:23:36Z. NEXT is a fresh bounded
F1/F2/integration recheck against review 5244965776, retaining the first
full review and the two-round workflow cap. Neither author nor fixer may
review it. No approval status was posted for c55a4069; the old adverse
review/status remains. Runtime activation and the first daemon-owned
580/587 batch remain pending; issue 593 stays open through that verification.

The resumed handoff adds four mathematical disposition requests. MAIN has
recorded these scoped decisions in opus-requests.txt for audited PRs and
fresh independent review:

- 542/527: review and integrate the unique seed-indexed contribution;
  retain the tensor-code correspondence and parameter-bound import as
  explicit source gaps until proved. No extra bridge hypothesis on the
  paper theorem and no claim that this packet resolves the import.
- 524: use approximate symmetrization with positive slack and the
  documented nonempty-answer boundary, reusing the given-strategy result.
  Preserve the exact-attainment assertion and obstruction in the source-gap
  record. Reuse 540's completed evidence rather than repeat its audit.
- 509/511: realign the supplied-point auxiliaries to polynomially controlled
  point error, following 389, and retain the established dimension factor.
  An unused duplicate may be removed after caller/provenance checks.
- 510: certify the already-proved established C*m error form as an explicit
  Lean-only result; keep the stronger printed assertion an open source gap.
  Coordinate all three Apply.lean sites in one packet, restore live tracking,
  and audit downstream statements and leanok placements. No speculative
  proof attempt at a known false or unsupported unchanged signature.

These decisions do not mark any source theorem complete. The Opus claim on
47 at 07:22:46Z is respected; its marginal-consistency proof will not be
duplicated. 594/591/588 remain available for other independent reviews.

The handoff's 07:21Z owner authorization restores one space-3 dispatched
slot; actual caps are primary 1 / second 0 / total 1. Relay-1 remains MAIN
plus at most one native. No lane was started this cycle. No native or own
CI process remains active; no runtime activation, live train, manual merge
or #168 post occurred.
